notes:
New in 0.9.0:
- Translate to English: Library ⋮ › Translate to English, or hold the gear in game › Translate to English….
- RPG Maker MV/MZ games: EdRoid translates the dialogue, menus and items on the phone with Google's offline translator (downloads once, about 30 MB). Switch back to the original at any time; the game folder isn't changed.
- Unity games (Mono): EdRoid adds a translator mod to the game folder, used from the next start; text turns English a moment after it appears. Unity IL2CPP games can't be translated yet.
- It's machine translation, and text drawn into pictures stays as it is.
- Fixed a crash that sometimes closed EdRoid as a Windows game's screen opened.
